declarations.text:
I confirm that I have made clear which facts and matters referred to in this report are within my own knowledge and which are not. Those that are within my own knowledge I confirm to be true. The opinions I have expressed represent my true and complete professional opinions on the matters to which they refer.

I understand that proceedings for contempt of court may be brought against anyone who makes, or causes to be made, a false statement in a document verified by a statement of truth without an honest belief in its truth.

deviations: The case bar's subtitle: the board shows a case description and status ("Delayed colorectal referral · report served"); the API has neither, the page shows the case type and due date. The artboard is rendered with the page's subtitle text for comparison (artboardCss).

Case bar: the step pills and avatar keep 52px hit areas (the board draws 44-46px); the bar's step links and avatar overhang by margin so the visible chips sit where the board draws them. Overrides are scoped to screens with a trial page (trial.css).

The "differs" note in row 3: the board says what the report said ("which said early March 2024, soon after the blood result"); the API has no earlier text, so the page says "This differs from your report (para N). Add a short note explaining why you've changed.". The artboard is rendered with that sentence (artboardCss).
Served paragraph numbers: the board shows "para 6.13"; the API returns whole numbers. The mock answers use the board's strings, the page prints what it is given.
Page numbers: the board writes p.087; the page writes p.87 (shared PageRef), the board's mock page in row 2 is 87 for that reason.
Each unchanged row has a "Change" link under its question (opens the editor; the board has no way to edit a position). It sits where the row already has spare height, so row heights match.
"Add a new version of the agenda (PDF)" sits right of the deadline chips; the board has no such link.

The date line says "Discussion on 12 February 2027" (with the year); the board omits the year. The footnote under the declarations keeps the page's words (the board's first sentence names the instructing party's plural, which the pack does not provide).
Row 3's columns carry a 3px, 2px, 1px left nudge: the board draws that row's 4px amber edge inside its grid, which pushes its columns right by those amounts.
Prepare button 19px/64px as drawn; the 'Prepare statement for signing' label is the page's.
The agenda line says (for the claimant) from the participant's side and the pack's party words, and question 3 reworded from the agenda comparison.
